title: Breaking upstream schema change (renamed column)
issue_description: The build_stg_orders_cleaned job is failing on every run with a database error, and stg_orders_cleaned / fct_daily_revenue haven't updated since the failure started.
ground_truth_root_cause: raw_orders.created_at was renamed to raw_orders.order_created_at (an upstream source schema change) but sql_models/01_stg_orders_cleaned.sql still references the old column name (o.created_at), so every run fails with a 'no such column: o.created_at' database error. Because the job fails before committing, stg_orders_cleaned and fct_daily_revenue are frozen at their last successful state rather than being corrupted.

ground_truth_location.detail: Column reference o.created_at in the SQL model no longer exists in raw_orders.
